arxiv-2103-16071.title: Approximate Nearest-Neighbor Search for Line Segments
arxiv-2103-16071.creator: Ahmed Abdelkader, David M. Mount
arxiv-2103-16071.description: Abstract Approximate nearest-neighbor search is a fundamental algorithmic problem that continues to inspire study due its essential role in numerous contexts. In contrast to most prior work, which has focused on point sets, we consider nearest-neighbor queries against a set of line segments in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} , for constant dimension d d .

arxiv-2202-07408.title: Coupled surface and bulk diffusion in crystals
arxiv-2202-07408.creator: S. S. Kosolobov
arxiv-2202-07408.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by S. S. Kosolobov. We analyze point defect bulk and surface diffusion near the crystal-vacuum interface and show that bulk diffusion is altered by atomic reactions at the surface-vacuum boundary. A new atomic mechanism for point defect generation and recombination is presented. In this mechanism, atomic steps are considered as sources and sinks not only for adsorbed atoms and surface vacancies but also for bulk native point defects — vacancies and self-interstitials.

arxiv-2310-05781.title: On variational inference and maximum likelihood estimation with the λ \lambda -exponential family
arxiv-2310-05781.creator: Thomas Guilmeau, Emilie Chouzenoux, Víctor Elvira
arxiv-2310-05781.description: Abstract The λ \lambda -exponential family has recently been proposed to generalize the exponential family. While the exponential family is well-understood and widely used, this is not the case yet for the λ \lambda -exponential family. However, many applications require models that are more general than the exponential family, and the λ \lambda -exponential family is often a good alternative.

arxiv-2311-09160.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Steven Hurder. In this work we relate the known results about the homotopy type of classifying spaces for smooth foliations, with the homology and cohomology of the discrete group of diffeomorphisms of a smooth compact connected oriented manifold. The Mather-Thurston Theorem forms a bridge between the results on the homotopy types of classifying spaces and the various homology and cohomology groups that are studied.

arxiv-2407-12900.creator: Dennis Schwarz
arxiv-2407-12900.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dennis Schwarz. In a recent article, we proposed an energy correlator-based method to achieve a precision top quark mass extraction from jet substructure, using the W W -boson mass as a standard candle. In this paper, we perform an extensive event generator simulation study of this proposal, testing its experimental viability and its sensitivity to different subprocesses in the top quark production and decay.

pmc-12595983.title: Low-Dose Esketamine Plus Dexmedetomidine in Patient-Controlled Intravenous Analgesia Improves Post-Cesarean Sleep Quality: A Double-Blind Randomized Trial
pmc-12595983.creator: Longyi Zhang, Yunzi He, Linlin Chen, Xianchun Liu, Ting Zhang, Xuelei Zhou, Wei Mao, Li Zhao, Linji Li, Ying Xie
pmc-12595983.description: PurposePostoperative sleep disturbance can hinder recovery after cesarean section. Although either esketamine or dexmedetomidine alone has been shown to improve sleep quality, their combined use in patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA) has not been well studied. This study aimed to evaluate whether adding dexmedetomidine to esketamine in PCIA could further enhance postoperative sleep quality in women after cesarean delivery.

pmc-12610611.description: Mercury (Hg) is a pervasive environmental contaminant with high bioavailability and toxicity, accumulating in aquatic food chains and posing significant risks to human health through seafood consumption.
